meta.title: Implement CloudFileAttachmentAdapter with promise-based uploads and progress bar support
meta.body_summary: Implements CloudFileAttachmentAdapter with promise-based uploads and progress bar in the registry template, claiming performance gains via parallel uploads.

core_change_summary.description: Added CloudFileAttachmentAdapter using XMLHttpRequest for uploading files to AssistantCloud with real-time progress via AsyncGenerator. Added progress primitives (ProgressRoot, ProgressIndicator) and integrated into shadcn registry attachment template.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most churn is in the new adapter and progress primitives; registry UI update is smaller.
change_trajectory: Replace mock progress with real XHR upload progress.
Add progress primitive components with separate scope.
Further formatting and refactor to use attachment context.

review_signals.summary: Suggested style improvements (CSS class naming, crypto.randomUUID for IDs) and noted empty remove() method.
Recommended adding onProgress(100) before resolution and fixing a potential race condition in the progress loop.
Flagged issues: inaccurate progress updates, missing abort handling, memory concerns with large files, and inefficient data storage.

collaboration_trajectory: Devin opened PR with cloud adapter and progress bar.
Multiple bot reviews appeared within minutes, pointing out progress inaccuracies, memory issues, and missing features.
Devin iterated on progress reporting and added primitive components.
No human maintainer responded throughout the 14‑day lifespan.
Devin bot auto‑closed the PR for inactivity.
